This new facility represents our continued investment in delivering an exceptional ownership experience and supporting the growing Lucid community throughout the region. We are building a talented team of service professionals who are passionate about innovation, customer excellence, and the future of sustainable transportation. Join us at an exciting time as we establish this state-of-the-art location and help shape the next chapter of Lucid's service operations from day one. jobs.title: Sr. 3D Generalist, UX
jobs.description_text: The Role We are looking for a Senior 3D Technical Artist & Motion Designer to join the Lucid UX/UI team and help define the next generation of digital vehicle experiences. This role sits at the intersection of 3D design, motion, real-time rendering, and product development. You will create high-quality vehicle visualizations, real-time 3D assets, animations, and motion experiences for customer-facing applications while ensuring that content performs efficiently within demanding embedded compute environments. You will work closely with UX/UI Designers, Vehicle Designers, Engineering, Product, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners to establish both the visual quality and the production processes required to bring sophisticated 3D experiences into production. The ideal candidate combines a strong visual eye with deep technical fluency. You should be equally comfortable refining lighting and materials in a 3D scene, rigging and animating a vehicle, optimizing an asset for a constrained GPU target, collaborating with engineers on implementation, and using emerging AI tools to accelerate and improve the creative workflow. What You'll Do Real-Time 3D & Visualization Create high-quality real-time 3D vehicle models, renderings, environments, and visual experiences for customer-facing UX applications. jobs.title: Sr. Design Engineer, Wire Harness
jobs.description_text: The Resident Launch Engineer is the plant-based engineering organization responsible for resolving product issues that impact vehicles in production. This Sr. Engineering role will be supporting Low Voltage Harness, across Lucid’s launch and production vehicle programs. The role exists to strengthen engineering ownership for launch and production issue triage, containment, root cause analysis, permanent corrective actions and cross-functional escalation management. In the first 12 months, success means establishing clear issue ownership, improving response time to production concerns, reducing repeat issues, and creating a stronger feedback loop between current production, future programs and core Vehicle Engineering teams. What you will find here that you will not find in a comparable role elsewhere is direct influence over complete vehicle system robustness across structural, closure, mechanical and electrical interfaces in a fast-moving EV manufacturing environment. What You'll Own Senior Engineering: Support the VHE organization across LV Harness, while balancing workloads and building capabilities for current production, launch support, and continuous improvement. Product Issue Resolution: Own engineering triage for production and field concerns, ensuring clear problem definition, risk assessment, containment, root cause investigation, corrective action planning and effectiveness verification.
